project: Engenharia Reversa - original REA Linux MCP
audit_purpose: Read-only audit of existing 121 scoped FULLY_CERTIFIED tools without rerunning or incrementing certifications; owner Ed25519 authorization, provider inventory, currently safe workflow and hygienization.

registry_integrity.tool_registry_sha_coverage_note: One registry row, inspect_with_objdump, carries historic Actions IDs and phase but no digest/evidence field in its own entry; other rows have at least one SHA/digest/evidence provenance property. This is a documentation-quality gap, not failure proof.

providers_live_checks.provider_health_qualification: Host SSH PATH is not equal to original persistent REA service environment. Frida local JS bindings and configured Rizin binary have historical positive functional proofs; blank CLI PATH does not itself prove failure. Global doctor unhealthy cannot be attributed to only IDA from present evidence.

auxiliary_preflight_failure.reason: PermissionError reading protected original service provider unblob binary as unprivileged SSH account in auxiliary preflight check

current_use_gates.read_prerequisites: All five read contracts certified; gdb_session_status needs a current live GDB session and verify_unknown_resolution an existing Unknown; the underlying session creation is sensitive.
current_use_gates.workspace_authorization: 103 workspace tools require per-operation exact signed-by-chat acknowledgement, no owner private key; some need previously staged provider sessions or target paths.
current_use_gates.sensitive_authorization: All thirteen sensitive tools are registered and have historical scoped positives. Eleven owner-signed original MCP positives occurred under Ed25519; two older functional positives are not evidence of the current signature-admission path. Every future sensitive call needs new matching Ed25519 from owner's Android.
current_use_gates.session_hold: Forty-one certified reviewed native inspection tools require open_binary within the same secure request; open_binary itself also remains under P232/P246 preservation hold, making at least 42 certified operations not currently safe to launch. Other tools may also need sessions, provider credentials, targets or platform availability.

audit_findings_prioritized.finding: Preserve the P232/P246 retention hold; no open_binary, close_binary, daemon restart or provider retirement before tested durable state restoration.
audit_findings_prioritized.effect: At least 42 certified operations currently gated by retention protection, despite historic correct functional results.
audit_findings_prioritized.action: No weakening or broad bypass; plan restore rehearsal/retention safety separately with owner approval.

audit_findings_prioritized.finding: Original service doctor still reports unhealthy/environment_healthy=false, with IDA unavailable, despite active core Ghidra/JADX/Kuna and configured CLI providers.
audit_findings_prioritized.effect: Cannot claim every certified tool/provider is universally ready on any target.
audit_findings_prioritized.action: Separate provider readiness issue from historical 121 scoped certifications; inspect only exact needed provider when advancing.

audit_findings_prioritized.finding: Inspect_web_network_capture and inspect_adb_client are sensitive in current audited policy, but P150 functional positives are pre-current-Ed25519 admission evidence.
audit_findings_prioritized.effect: Live functional parsing/client introspection proven historically, current owner-signed end-to-end execution not demonstrated for these two tools.
audit_findings_prioritized.action: Preserve certifications scoped; request fresh owner signed exact tests only if stringent current-policy revalidation is desired, not claim already validated.

audit_findings_prioritized.finding: One old certificate row inspect_with_objdump lacks SHA/digest metadata field while listing four historical run IDs.
audit_findings_prioritized.action: Retain historic certification and runs; no re-certification solely due to metadata omission.

audit_findings_prioritized.finding: Prior latest current incident followup points at older 119/208, 10 Evidence and zero Unknowns though current verified state is 121/208, 11 Evidence, 1 Unknown.
audit_findings_prioritized.effect: Stale nested current-state pointer can mislead a future session.
audit_findings_prioritized.action: Hygienize only current-state metadata while retaining P225/P254 historical observations.
